question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are dancers at a square dance. At the start of a song, they each have a partner: Alice is dancing with Umar, Bob is dancing with Stefan, Claire is dancing with Lena, Dave is dancing with Karl, and Eve is dancing with Priya.
Throughout the song, the dancers often trade partners. First, Alice and Bob switch partners. Then, Alice and Bob switch partners. Then, Bob and Dave switch partners. Then, Alice and Claire switch partners. Finally, Eve and Bob switch partners. At the end of the dance, Dave is dancing with
Options:
(A) Umar
(B) Stefan
(C) Lena
(D) Karl
(E) Priya
solution:
Each row lists the partners of Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve, in that order.
Initial: Umar | Stefan | Lena | Karl | Priya
After the first Alice–Bob swap: Stefan | Umar | Lena | Karl | Priya
After the second Alice–Bob swap: Umar | Stefan | Lena | Karl | Priya
After Bob–Dave: Umar | Karl | Lena | Stefan | Priya
After Alice–Claire: Lena | Karl | Umar | Stefan | Priya
After Eve–Bob: Lena | Priya | Umar | Stefan | Karl
Dave is dancing with Stefan, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
